ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287\t        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288\t\n289\t        return true;\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293\t    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294\t    template<typename Func>\n295\t    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296\t        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297\t        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n298\t            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n299\t                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n300\t            }\n301\t            return false;\n302\t        }\n303\t\n304\t        // Otherwise, descend to children\n305\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n306\t            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n307\t                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n308\t            }\n309\t        }\n310\t        return false;\n311\t    }\n312\t};\n313\t\n314\t// ============================================================================\n315\t// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n316\t// ============================================================================\n317\t\n318\t// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\n319\tclass IcosphereMesh {\n320\tpublic:\n321\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n531\t    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n532\t    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n533\t    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n534\t    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n535\t\n536\t    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n542\t};\n543\t\n544\t// ============================================================================\n545\t// Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549\t                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550\t    // Generate mesh\n551\t    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n552\t    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n566\t        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n567\t    }\n568\t\n569\t    // Initialize reflectivity\n570\t    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n571\t\n572\t    // Initialize matrices\n573\t    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n574\t    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n575\t    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n576\t    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n577\t    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t            if (i == j) continue;\n598\t            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n599\t                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n600\t        }\n601\t        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608\t    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n609\t\n610\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n611\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n612\t            if (i == j) continue;\n613\t            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n614\t                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n615\t        }\n616\t    }\n617\t}\n618\t\n619\t// ============================================================================\n620\t// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634\t\n635\t                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n636\t                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n637\t\n638\t                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n639\t                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n640\t\n641\t                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n642\t                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n647\t                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n648\t            }\n649\t\n650\t            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// ============================================================================\n661\t// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n662\t// ============================================================================\n663\t\n664\tvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n665\t    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n666\t\n667\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n668\t        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n669\t        int bestT = 0;\n670\t\n671\t        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n672\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n673\t            val_t sum = ZERO;\n674\t\n675\t            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n676\t                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n677\t                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];\n678\t                sum += pS * pB;\n679\t            }\n680\t\n681\t            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n682\t                maxCorr = sum;\n683\t                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n684\t            }\n685\t        }\n686\t\n687\t        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n688\t    }\n689\t}\n690\t\n691\t// ============================================================================\n692\t// Validation\n693\t// ============================================================================\n694\t\n695\tbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n696\t    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n697\t\n698\t    // Check that distances are non-negative\n699\t    bool allNonNegative = true;\n700\t    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n701\t    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n702\t    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n703\t    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n704\t\n705\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n706\t        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n707\t        if (d < 0) {\n708\t            allNonNegative = false;\n709\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n710\t        }\n711\t        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n712\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n713\t            return false;\n714\t        }\n715\t        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n716\t        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n717\t        sumDist += d;\n718\t        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n719\t    }\n720\t\n721\t    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n722\t    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n723\t    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n724\t\n725\t    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n726\t    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n727\t    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n728\t        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n729\t    }\n730\t\n731\t    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n732\t    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n733\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n734\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n735\t            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n736\t                receivedEnergy++;\n737\t                break;\n738\t            }\n739\t        }\n740\t    }\n741\t\n742\t    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n743\t\n744\t    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n745\t        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n746\t        return false;\n747\t    }\n748\t\n749\t    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n750\t    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n751\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n752\t        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n753\t    }\n754\t    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n755\t           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n756\t           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n757\t\n758\t    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n759\t        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n760\t        return false;\n761\t    }\n762\t\n763\t    if (!allNonNegative) {\n764\t        return false;\n765\t    }\n766\t\n767\t    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n768\t    return true;\n769\t}\n770\t\n771\t// ============================================================================\n772\t// Hash for Verification\n773\t// ============================================================================\n774\t\n775\tuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n776\t    uint64_t hash = 0;\n777\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n778\t        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n779\t        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n780\t    }\n781\t    return hash;\n782\t}\n783\t\n784\t// ============================================================================\n785\t// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n786\t// ============================================================================\n787\t\n788\tint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n789\t    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n790\t    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n791\t    int subdivisions = 0;\n792\t    int triangles = 20;\n793\t    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n794\t        subdivisions++;\n795\t        triangles *= 4;\n796\t    }\n797\t    return subdivisions;\n798\t}\n799\t\n800\t// ============================================================================\n801\t// Main\n802\t// ============================================================================\n803\t\n804\tvoid ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t static_cast<int>(geo.leafTris.size() / 3);\n            count = -static_cast<int>(node->triangleIndices.size());\n            for (size_t idx : node->triangleIndices) {\n                const Triangle& t = tris[idx];\n                float4 a = make_float4(t.a.x, t.a.y, t.a.z, __int_as_float(static_cast<int>(idx)));\n                geo.leafTris.push_back(a);\n                geo.leafTris.push_back(make_float4(t.b.x, t.b.y, t.b.z, 0.f));\n                geo.leafTris.push_back(make_float4(t.c.x, t.c.y, t.c.z, 0.f));\n            }\n        } else {\n            first = static_cast<int>(order.size());\n            count = 0;\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                if (node->children[i]) {\n                    order.push_back(node->children[i].get());\n                    ++count;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        g.h = make_float4(node->halfExtent.y, node->halfExtent.z,\n                          __int_as_float(first), __int_as_float(count));\n        if (q >= geo.nodes.size()) geo.nodes.resize(q + 1);\n        geo.nodes[q] = g;\n    }\n    geo.nodes.resize(order.size());\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device Geometry Routines (same math as the sequential version)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 f3(float4 v) { return make_float3(v.x, v.y, v.z); }\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 sub3(float3 a, float3 b) { return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z); }\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 add3(float3 a, float3 b) { return make_float3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z); }\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 mul3(float3 a, float s) { return make_float3(a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s); }\n__device__ __forceinline__ float dot3(float3 a, float3 b) { return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z; }\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 cross3(float3 a, float3 b) {\n    return make_float3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x);\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool gpuRayIntersectsBox(const GpuNode& n, float3 p1, float3 p2) {\n    float3 d = mul3(sub3(p2, p1), 0.5f);\n    float3 c = sub3(add3(p1, d), make_float3(n.c.x, n.c.y, n.c.z));\n    float hx = n.c.w, hy = n.h.x, hz = n.h.y;\n    float adx = fabsf(d.x), ady = fabsf(d.y), adz = fabsf(d.z);\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > hx + adx) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > hy + ady) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > hz + adz) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > hy * adz + hz * ady + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > hz * adx + hx * adz + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > hx * ady + hy * adx + EPSILON) return false;\n    return true;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float gpuRayTriangleIntersect(float3 orig, float3 dir, float3 v0, float3 v1, float3 v2) {\n    const float NO_HIT = 3.402823466e+38f;\n    float3 e1 = sub3(v1, v0);\n    float3 e2 = sub3(v2, v0);\n    float3 pvec = cross3(dir, e2);\n    float det = dot3(e1, pvec);\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return NO_HIT;\n\n    float invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    float3 tvec = sub3(orig, v0);\n    float u = dot3(tvec, pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return NO_HIT;\n\n    float3 qvec = cross3(tvec, e1);\n    float v = dot3(dir, qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return NO_HIT;\n\n    return dot3(e2, qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\nconstexpr int OCTREE_STACK = 96;\n\n__device__ bool gpuIsRayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to, const GpuNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                                const float4* __restrict__ leafTris, int srcIdx, int dstIdx) {\n    float3 dir = sub3(to, from);\n    float rayLen = sqrtf(dot3(dir, dir));\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    float3 dirNorm = make_float3(dir.x / rayLen, dir.y / rayLen, dir.z / rayLen);\n\n    int stack[OCTREE_STACK];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        GpuNode node = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        int first = __float_as_int(node.h.z);\n        int count = __float_as_int(node.h.w);\n        if (count < 0) {\n            for (int t = 0; t < -count; ++t) {\n                const float4* tp = leafTris + 3 * static_cast<size_t>(first + t);\n                float4 a = __ldg(tp);\n                int idx = __float_as_int(a.w);\n                if (idx == srcIdx || idx == dstIdx) continue;\n                float dist = gpuRayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, f3(a), f3(__ldg(tp + 1)), f3(__ldg(tp + 2)));\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Push in reverse so children are visited in their original order\n            for (int c = count - 1; c >= 0; --c) {\n                GpuNode child = nodes[first + c];\n                if (gpuRayIntersectsBox(child, from, to)) stack[sp++] = first + c;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr int KIJ_TILE = 128;\n\n// Pair (i, j) consumes random numbers iff i != j and the normals are not\n// (nearly) parallel. Must be evaluated identically everywhere.\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool pairActive(const float4* __restrict__ normals, int i, int j) {\n    if (i == j) return false;\n    float4 a = __ldg(normals + i);\n    float4 b = __ldg(normals + j);\n    float d = __fmaf_rn(a.z, b.z, __fmaf_rn(a.y, b.y, __fmul_rn(a.x, b.x)));\n    return !(d > 0.99f);\n}\n\n// Count active pairs per (row, tile)\n__global__ void countActiveKernel(const float4* __restrict__ normals, int n, int numTiles,\n                                  uint32_t* __restrict__ tileCounts) {\n    int i = blockIdx.y;\n    int j = blockIdx.x * KIJ_TILE + threadIdx.x;\n    bool active = j < n && pairActive(normals, i, j);\n    int cnt = __syncthreads_count(active);\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) tileCounts[static_cast<size_t>(i) * numTiles + blockIdx.x] = cnt;\n}\n\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(KIJ_TILE)\nformFactorKernel(int n, int rowBegin, int numTiles,\n                 const float4* __restrict__ tris,      // 4 per triangle: a, b, c, normal\n                 const float4* __restrict__ normals,\n                 const float* __restrict__ areas,\n                 const GpuNode* __restrict__ nodes, const float4* __restrict__ leafTris,\n                 const uint64_t* __restrict__ tileRank, uint64_t batchRankBegin,\n                 const float* __restrict__ randoms,\n                 float2* __restrict__ simCoef,          // transposed: [j * n + i] = (weight, tau)\n                 unsigned long long* __restrict__ nonZeroCount) {\n    __shared__ int warpCounts[KIJ_TILE / 32];\n    const int i = rowBegin + blockIdx.y;\n    const int j = blockIdx.x * KIJ_TILE + threadIdx.x;\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31, warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n\n    bool active = j < n && pairActive(normals, i, j);\n\n    // Rank of this pair among active pairs (row-major order)\n    unsigned ballot = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, active);\n    if (lane == 0) warpCounts[warp] = __popc(ballot);\n    __syncthreads();\n    int local = __popc(ballot & ((1u << lane) - 1u));\n    for (int w = 0; w < warp; ++w) local += warpCounts[w];\n\n    float kij = 0.0f;\n    if (active) {\n        uint64_t rank = tileRank[static_cast<size_t>(i) * numTiles + blockIdx.x] + local - batchRankBegin;\n        const float4* rnd = reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(randoms + rank * RANDS_PER_PAIR);\n\n        const float4* ti = tris + 4 * static_cast<size_t>(i);\n        const float4* tj = tris + 4 * static_cast<size_t>(j);\n        float3 aI = f3(ti[0]), abI = sub3(f3(ti[1]), aI), acI = sub3(f3(ti[2]), aI), nI = f3(ti[3]);\n        float3 aJ = f3(tj[0]), abJ = sub3(f3(tj[1]), aJ), acJ = sub3(f3(tj[2]), aJ), nJ = f3(tj[3]);\n\n        for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n            float4 q = rnd[r];\n            float u = q.x, v = q.y;\n            if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }\n            float3 pI = add3(add3(aI, mul3(abI, u)), mul3(acI, v));\n            u = q.z; v = q.w;\n            if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }\n            float3 pJ = add3(add3(aJ, mul3(abJ, u)), mul3(acJ, v));\n\n            if (gpuIsRayBlocked(pI, pJ, nodes, leafTris, i, j)) continue;\n\n            float3 dv = sub3(pJ, pI);\n            float distSqr = dot3(dv, dv);\n            if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n            float vNorm = sqrtf(distSqr);\n            if (vNorm <= EPSILON) continue;\n            float cosPhiI = fmaxf(0.0f, dot3(dv, nI) / vNorm);\n            float cosPhiJ = fmaxf(0.0f, dot3(make_float3(-dv.x, -dv.y, -dv.z), nJ) / vNorm);\n            if (cosPhiI <= 0.0f || cosPhiJ <= 0.0f) continue;\n\n            kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n        }\n        kij *= INV_NUM_RAYS;\n    }\n\n    if (j < n) {\n        // Effective coupling used by the simulation: min(kij * area_j, 1), 0 if kij <= 0\n        float w = kij > 0.0f ? fminf(kij * areas[j], 1.0f) : 0.0f;\n        float2* dst = simCoef + static_cast<size_t>(j) * n + i;\n        float2 c = *dst;  // tau already stored in .y\n        c.x = w;\n        *dst = c;\n    }\n    int nz = __syncthreads_count(j < n && kij > EPSILON);\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0 && nz) atomicAdd(nonZeroCount, static_cast<unsigned long long>(nz));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\n__global__ void timeDelayKernel(int n, const float4* __restrict__ centers, float2* __restrict__ simCoef) {\n    int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;  // receiver (contiguous)\n    int j = blockIdx.y;                             // emitter\n    if (i >= n) return;\n    int tau = 0;\n    if (i != j) {\n        float3 d = sub3(f3(centers[i]), f3(centers[j]));\n        float dist = sqrtf(dot3(d, d));\n        tau = static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n    }\n    simCoef[static_cast<size_t>(j) * n + i] = make_float2(0.0f, __int_as_float(tau));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n    uint64_t nonZeroKij = 0;        // Number of form factors > EPSILON\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // Device data\n    float4* dTris = nullptr;        // a, b, c, normal per triangle\n    float4* dNormals = nullptr;\n    float4* dCenters = nullptr;\n    float* dAreas = nullptr;\n    float* dRho = nullptr;\n    GpuNode* dNodes = nullptr;\n    float4* dLeafTris = nullptr;\n    float2* dSimCoef = nullptr;     // N x N, transposed [j][i]: (min(kij*area_j,1), tau_ij)\n    float* dRadE = nullptr;\n    float* dRadB = nullptr;\n    float* dDistances = nullptr;\n\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Initialize the CUDA context up front\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));\n\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// Upload geometry and per-triangle data to the GPU\nstatic void uploadGeometry(SimulationState& state) {\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    std::vector<float4> tris(4 * n), normals(n), centers(n);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const Triangle& t = state.triangles[i];\n        Vec3 nr = t.normal(), c = t.center();\n        tris[4 * i + 0] = make_float4(t.a.x, t.a.y, t.a.z, 0.f);\n        tris[4 * i + 1] = make_float4(t.b.x, t.b.y, t.b.z, 0.f);\n        tris[4 * i + 2] = make_float4(t.c.x, t.c.y, t.c.z, 0.f);\n        tris[4 * i + 3] = make_float4(nr.x, nr.y, nr.z, 0.f);\n        normals[i] = tris[4 * i + 3];\n        centers[i] = make_float4(c.x, c.y, c.z, 0.f);\n    }\n    GpuGeometry geo;\n    flattenOctree(state.octree, state.triangles, geo);\n\n    state.dTris = deviceAlloc<float4>(tris.size());\n    state.dNormals = deviceAlloc<float4>(n);\n    state.dCenters = deviceAlloc<float4>(n);\n    state.dAreas = deviceAlloc<float>(n);\n    state.dRho = deviceAlloc<float>(n);\n    state.dNodes = deviceAlloc<GpuNode>(geo.nodes.size());\n    state.dLeafTris = deviceAlloc<float4>(geo.leafTris.size());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTris, tris.data(), tris.size() * sizeof(float4), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNormals, normals.data(), n * sizeof(float4), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dCenters, centers.data(), n * sizeof(float4), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dAreas, state.areas.data(), n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRho, state.rho.data(), n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNodes, geo.nodes.data(), geo.nodes.size() * sizeof(GpuNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dLeafTris, geo.leafTris.data(), geo.leafTris.size() * sizeof(float4),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    state.dSimCoef = deviceAlloc<float2>(n * n);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    const int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    const int numTiles = (n + KIJ_TILE - 1) / KIJ_TILE;\n\n    // 1. Rank of every (row, tile) among active pairs => offsets into the RNG stream\n    uint32_t* dTileCounts = deviceAlloc<uint32_t>(static_cast<size_t>(n) * numTiles);\n    countActiveKernel<<<dim3(numTiles, n), KIJ_TILE>>>(state.dNormals, n, numTiles, dTileCounts);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    std::vector<uint32_t> tileCounts(static_cast<size_t>(n) * numTiles);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(tileCounts.data(), dTileCounts, tileCounts.size() * sizeof(uint32_t),\n                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dTileCounts));\n\n    std::vector<uint64_t> tileRank(static_cast<size_t>(n) * numTiles + 1);\n    uint64_t acc = 0;\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < tileCounts.size(); ++k) {\n        tileRank[k] = acc;\n        acc += tileCounts[k];\n    }\n    tileRank.back() = acc;\n    const uint64_t totalPairs = acc;\n    uint64_t* dTileRank = deviceAlloc<uint64_t>(tileRank.size());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dTileRank, tileRank.data(), tileRank.size() * sizeof(uint64_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    auto rowRank = [&](int i) { return tileRank[static_cast<size_t>(i) * numTiles]; };\n\n    // 2. Start producing MT snapshots on the host (overlaps with GPU work)\n    const uint64_t totalWords = totalPairs * RANDS_PER_PAIR;\n    const uint64_t totalTwists = (totalWords + MT_N - 1) / MT_N;\n    const uint64_t maxSnaps = 65536;\n    const int twistsPerSnap = static_cast<int>(std::max<uint64_t>(16, (totalTwists + maxSnaps - 1) / maxSnaps));\n    const size_t numSnaps = static_cast<size_t>((totalTwists + twistsPerSnap - 1) / twistsPerSnap);\n    SnapshotProducer producer(numSnaps, twistsPerSnap);\n    const uint64_t wordsPerSnap = static_cast<uint64_t>(twistsPerSnap) * MT_N;\n\n    // 3. Process rows in batches bounded by the random-number buffer size\n    const uint64_t maxBatchWords = std::max<uint64_t>(uint64_t(1) << 27, static_cast<uint64_t>(n) * RANDS_PER_PAIR);\n    float* dRandoms = deviceAlloc<float>(maxBatchWords);\n    const size_t maxBatchSnaps = maxBatchWords / wordsPerSnap + 2;\n    uint32_t* dSnaps = deviceAlloc<uint32_t>(maxBatchSnaps * MT_N);\n    unsigned long long* dNonZero = deviceAlloc<unsigned long long>(1);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dNonZero, 0, sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n\n    int nextProgress = 100;\n    for (int rowBegin = 0; rowBegin < n;) {\n        int rowEnd = rowBegin + 1;\n        while (rowEnd < n && (rowRank(rowEnd + 1 <= n ? rowEnd + 1 : n) - rowRank(rowBegin)) * 0 +\n                                     ((rowEnd + 1 < n ? rowRank(rowEnd + 1) : totalPairs) - rowRank(rowBegin)) *\n                                     RANDS_PER_PAIR <= maxBatchWords) {\n            ++rowEnd;\n        }\n        const uint64_t rankBegin = rowRank(rowBegin);\n        const uint64_t rankEnd = rowEnd < n ? rowRank(rowEnd) : totalPairs;\n        const uint64_t wordBegin = rankBegin * RANDS_PER_PAIR;\n        const uint64_t wordEnd = rankEnd * RANDS_PER_PAIR;\n\n        if (wordEnd > wordBegin) {\n            size_t snapBegin = static_cast<size_t>(wordBegin / wordsPerSnap);\n            size_t snapEnd = static_cast<size_t>((wordEnd + wordsPerSnap - 1) / wordsPerSnap);\n            const uint32_t* snaps = producer.waitFor(snapEnd);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dSnaps, snaps + snapBegin * MT_N,\n                                       (snapEnd - snapBegin) * MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            generateRandomsKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned>(snapEnd - snapBegin), 256>>>(\n                dSnaps, snapBegin, twistsPerSnap, wordBegin, wordEnd, dRandoms);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n        formFactorKernel<<<dim3(numTiles, rowEnd - rowBegin), KIJ_TILE>>>(\n            n, rowBegin, numTiles, state.dTris, state.dNormals, state.dAreas, state.dNodes, state.dLeafTris,\n            dTileRank, rankBegin, dRandoms, state.dSimCoef, dNonZero);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        while (nextProgress <= rowEnd) {\n            printf(\"  Progress: %d/%d triangles\\n\", nextProgress, n);\n            nextProgress += 100;\n        }\n        if (rowEnd == n && n % 100 != 0) printf(\"  Progress: %d/%d triangles\\n\", n, n);\n        rowBegin = rowEnd;\n    }\n\n    unsigned long long nonZero = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&nonZero, dNonZero, sizeof(nonZero), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    state.nonZeroKij = nonZero;\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dRandoms));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dSnaps));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dNonZero));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dTileRank));\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n    uploadGeometry(state);\n    const int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    timeDelayKernel<<<dim3((n + 255) / 256, n), 256>>>(n, state.dCenters, state.dSimCoef);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One thread per receiver i; contributions are accumulated in the original\n// sequential j order so results match the reference bit for bit.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(128)\nsimulationStepKernel(int n, int t, const float2* __restrict__ simCoef, const float* __restrict__ rho,\n                     const float* __restrict__ radE, float* __restrict__ radB) {\n    int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= n) return;\n    float sumB = 0.0f;\n    const float2* col = simCoef + i;\n#pragma unroll 8\n    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        float2 c = __ldg(col + static_cast<size_t>(j) * n);\n        int tauij = __float_as_int(c.y);\n        if (j == i || t < tauij || c.x <= 0.0f) continue;\n        float radJ = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - tauij) * n + j];\n        if (radJ <= 0.0f) continue;\n        sumB = __fmaf_rn(c.x, radJ, sumB);\n    }\n    size_t o = Phase\n1361\t// ============================================================================\n1362\t\n1363\tstatic std::mutex deferredMutex_;\n1364\t\n1365\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& There's no comparison against the original, which would take days.\n\n**How it works**\n- **Random numbers:** the original draws from one sequential `mt19937` stream, 64 numbers per pair of triangles. To keep that exact sequence, host threads record generator snapshots, using a jump-ahead method so several threads can work in parallel. GPU blocks then regenerate the numbers from the snapshots. Each pair finds its 64 numbers by counting the earlier pairs that use random numbers.\n- **Floating-point matching:** the original build lets gcc fuse multiply-adds in some places and not others (Zen 3 tuning). The GPU code turns off automatic fusing and copies gcc's choices by hand. Without this, some long runs differed from the original (e.g. 1280 triangles, 200 timesteps).\n- **Form factors** (the expensive part): the batches are shared out across all GPUs. Within a GPU, a warp traces the 16 rays of two triangle pairs through the octree together. Each ray still checks exactly the same triangles as in the original; only the visiting order differs, which can't change a yes/no \"blocked\" answer.\n- **Simulation:** each GPU simulates the triangles whose rows it computed, so the big matrix never moves between GPUs. Each step, the GPUs exchange only the new values. Each triangle's sum is still added in the original order, and the time delays are recomputed on the fly with the same formula.\n- **Distances:** computed on one GPU, with the original's tie-breaking (earliest best time wins).\n\n**Things you should know**\n- The program always uses every visible GPU. These GPUs can't copy directly to each other, so the per-step exchange goes through host memory.\n- `CMakeLists.txt` now compiles `roomsim.cpp` as CUDA and targets the build machine's GPU (falling back to sm_86 on CMake older than 3.24). It also passes flags that the exact matching depends on.\n- I moved freeing GPU memory to after the timers stop; the original also only releases memory at exit.\n- The original's form-factor counter overflows at 81920 triangles and prints a negative number.
